description: ROME causal tracing, total effect (Meng et al. 2022, arXiv:2202.05262): corrupt subject-token embeddings of gpt2-xl with seeded Gaussian noise at scale 3*sigma of the embedding matrix (sigma measured 0.048227 from the public weights by tests/golden/fixtures/generators/gen_counterfact.py, so 3*sigma = 0.144681 - the paper's 3*sigma, not sqrt(3*sigma)). The seed is a 3-value sweep axis standing in for the paper's noise resamples; the clean forward is off-axis and interns to one shared run. Width-5 shard (see gen_counterfact.py: one document per equal subject-token width, pooled by the test). ATE = mean over facts and seeds of P_clean(object) - P_corrupted(object), computed post-hoc from the cross_entropy tables (p = exp(-ce)); golden band [10.6, 26.6] percentage points around the paper's 18.6.
